item.title: 2D materials synthesis
item.description:
I develop CVD growth and transfer processes for graphene, hexagonal boron nitride and transition-metal dichalcogenides. At the Cambridge Graphene Centre, my work included wafer-scale synthesis and process development within the Graphene Flagship.

item.description:
Workflows that compare candidate materials with crystallographic databases and published literature, helping identify prior reports and prioritise experimental follow-up.

item.title: Diffraction analysis & simulation
item.description:
Tools for analysing selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns and simulating XRD and SAED patterns to support structural interpretation.

item.title: In-situ electron microscopy
item.description:
I use heating and electrical biasing in the TEM to study catalytic graphitisation, electromigration and the formation of carbon nanostructures. Direct observation helps connect intermediate changes with the final material.

item.title: Waste-derived carbon
item.description:
My work includes graphene growth from solid waste plastics and collaborative studies using waste chicken fat and other waste or renewable precursors. The central question is how precursor and catalyst choices influence the carbon product.
